effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] While you have another Digimon in play with the [X Antibody] trait, or a card with the [X Antibody] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While this Digimon has the [X Antibody] trait, it gets +1000 DP.
